state:
Classify investment priorities for three invented buyers using only the supplied material. This is advice about the eventual Can product, assuming its specified infrastructure, compiler and common libraries have been delivered coherently. The fact that this repository contains design drafts is neutral; unsupported business behavior in those drafts and uncertain maintenance obligations still matter. These are not interviews, runtime tests or observed purchase decisions. Frozen reference: baseline-20261004T041647Z/snapshot, supplemented by independent evaluation artifacts.

Buyer P employs25 people across3 departments and operates500 equipment-request records plus80 expenses each month; it brings2,000 old records/receipts. Workers would fill browser forms or invoke approved chatbot tools. Operations signs off business rules, finance records repayment evidence, and an outside technical maintainer installs/releases/supports the system. It needs private employee requests, manager access limited to current departments, stale-write denial, permission-preserving CSV review/export, retained submitted receipts, eligible nonself reviewers, linked corrections and accurate reimbursement status. Payroll/accounting, actual bank transfers and ordinary office mail are retained. Can models/policies/canonical operation interfaces and pinned authentication/team/database/browser/MCP defaults can describe this scope; the tiny register does not require billing or email accounts. A Can attempt and a Django attempt each statically expressed8 register cases, but adopted different privacy toggles, duplicate handling and bounds. Their source lengths cannot establish equivalent coverage savings or interaction/billing cost. Both later narrowing drafts refuse to truncate an overlong archived title; inherited immutable archive rules need an explicit historical business disposition. That is a shared ownership-policy responsibility, not a Can-only defect. Expense source presently admits an assigned active coworker without the review-role grant, freezes that assignment, and lacks narrow later-revocation recovery. It needs that app correction. How staff recognize a reviewer while protecting directory information remains an open selection study, not an established inability. The additional finance-approval rule for >EUR500 is described in production source, yet a success example requires three separate people in one team while the test contract supplies two; specify the narrow test-account boundary before claiming that example coverage.

Buyer W has12 employees running2 locations for120 customer businesses and600 members with30 rooms and100 pooled desks. Monthly volume is3,000 room bookings,500 invoices,300 mail pieces and30,000 messages. The operations director is accountable for uninterrupted service; a contracted specialist maintains adapters/releases. External customers receive restricted company/member access. Required incumbent workflows include customer records/identity, offer-to-reservation-to-collected-invoice, membership, reception, mail, source-based reports, migration and recovery across owners. Multiple Can modules comprise one alternative and can share a deployment; do not demand unused vendor features, award each module a saving or assume each needs a separate service. The buyer retains payments, accounting/payroll, mail/domain, physical-access supplier and appropriate support. Source specifies permissions, fixed commercial evidence, payment vs delivery outcomes and retry/correlation. Nonetheless current cleanup loops reject an entire batch when101 candidates exceed100 and leave no progress; an enduring verified-contact invariant conflicts with delegate revocation; an incomplete but fresh report checkpoint may aggregate to exact zero. A no-billing Mail variant still requires billing/member executable dependency installation. Historical room evidence repeatedly embeds all retained booking values: B sequential bookings yield B(B+1)/2 copies, including5,050 at100 and500,500 at1000; this is structural arithmetic, not storage or speed measurement. Same-commit coalescing only removes local duplication, whereas narrower evidence introduces reporting/reconstruction work. Existing predicate/current-admission/work-scheduling/completeness features offer specific correction routes. Equal-criteria source/cost review has not determined which optional dependency or historical representation alternative serves the same outcomes best. All required broader membership/reception/import paths must still be accepted before full suite charges are avoidable. Prior frozen history and attachments need a reviewed specialist intake mapping or retained archive; ordinary CSV alone does not establish their restoration. Desired Rent JavaScript manually uses a currency-unit constructor on sums of minor units and omits checked-money lowering in some paths; this is target drift to correct, not generated/executed financial failure. Explicit Can minor projections are not inherently invalid.

Buyer S is a40-person service contractor with15 mobile technicians,200 weekly jobs and5,000 assets. Record-based inspections, assignments, parts receipts and reports are suitable candidates. Required offline mapping and efficient vehicle routing rely on a specialized foundation outside Can scope. The full suite remains necessary; an isolated module could coexist but would keep that subscription, integration and continuity burden. Neither a cancelled fee nor labor reduction for such a module is demonstrated.

The financial horizon is24 months in USD ASSUMPTION units. Let P cancel exactly450/month only after replacement: low support costs740 incremental setup plus40/month and1month overlap, giving8,650 savings; high support2420 plus355/month with2 overlap gives -1,040. Let W avoid900/month only when ALL its requirements pass: low5220 setup plus150/month with2 overlap gives10,980; high15140 plus1015/month with4 overlap gives -21,500. Future incumbent configuration/people/support and Can steward/staff/platform/providers are charged on each side. Rates assumed100/hour technical and35/hour staff; Can needs1-4 technical hours/month P or4-12 W. Reusable shared platform development is not re-billed as a rebuild per customer, but its funding/support allowance is not zero. Provider documentation currently lists a5/month Workers account minimum shared across modules;30k W email adds9.45, so14.45 is only a base+mail subtotal excluding other metering, payments, domains, backup, software and labor. Paid mail is Beta and sender/volume approval depends on the account. Paid D1 has30-day Time Travel for database recovery, independent of code/file/provider state. A whole-source/schema/data/file/config runbook, fenced writes and external-payment reconciliation are needed; a config-only provider switch should reuse release compatibility gates with the original unresolved receipt namespace. Legal residency/recovery targets and organizational access policy are unspecified buyer decisions, and no certification is asserted.

Compare a continued configurable incumbent with no present Can allocation, a capped future Can learning pilot with no promise to replace, and a budget commitment to build the complete composed replacement (cutover only if the fixed coverage/cost/recovery gates pass). Pilot work also costs technical and business staff time, providers and setup while the current subscriptions continue. Its cost is unquoted and nonzero, a quote/cap must precede expenditure, and the validation itself might not justify that cost. A possible scope is P isolated register/expense review, W shadow commercial/mail/report evidence without migration, S independent inspections with route/offline retained. Do not assume a low pilot budget or a whole-app fixed-price offer. Use the same business usefulness, necessary paths, technical responsibility, exit/migration risk, alternative configuration options and economic uncertainty when classifying each buyer's next step. Your results remain simulated advice, not demand or measured willingness to spend.

P.instructions: Select P's most warranted immediate allocation, using the supplied eventual-product scenario and both cost cases at450/month.

criteria.retain: Use existing configurable products for this round and reserve no budget for Can study or delivery.
criteria.pilot: Seek a priced/capped plan for just the specified future P learning test, keep current tools, and decide on any replacement only after evidence.
criteria.replace: Set aside resources for full composed P replacement despite remaining corrections and support estimates, with actual transition conditional on the fixed behavior/economic criteria.

W.instructions: What is W's best-supported next funding path under the stipulated900/month cancellable price and complete continuity obligations?

criteria.retain: Stay with and adjust the incumbent system now without spending on Can; accept its continuing costs and service arrangement.
criteria.pilot: Pay only for the stated future shadow W validation, keeping customers on current service and deferring a replacement decision.
criteria.replace: Finance the entire W composed replacement effort now, including required corrections/retained integrations, but permit exit only after all unchanged data, workflow and recovery gates succeed.

S.instructions: Choose S's defensible next allocation with route/offline software still indispensable and inspection-module value not yet quantified.

criteria.retain: Continue configuring the current field products and make no Can investment in this choice.
criteria.pilot: Run only the bounded later inspection-record trial alongside retained routing/offline software; make no claim of full-suite savings or committed replacement.
criteria.replace: Allocate a programme for partial Can records/inspection replacement immediately, retaining offline/routing fees and enforcing migration/support/acceptance conditions despite unknown bill/time benefit.
